Zanjeerain (2026) is the latest collaboration between director Shahzad Kashmiri and writer Farhat Ishtiaq - the same celebrated duo behind Yakeen Ka Safar, and produced by Momina Duraid. From the very first frame, it announces itself as something grander and more atmospheric than the average primetime serial.
The story unfolds against the breathtaking backdrop of lush green mountains, weaving together a world where love, greed, and buried secrets collide. Everyone in this world is hiding something, some are imprisoned by old customs and inherited loyalties, others are consumed by hunger for power, and some are simply trying, desperately, to shield the people they love.
At the centre of it all is Rabia, played by Sajal Aly, a young woman who runs a modest dhaba with her brother, grounded and self-sufficient in a world that constantly threatens to swallow people like her whole.
On the other side of the social divide is Sar Buland, played by Danyal Zafar, son of a prominent family embroiled in a bitter, long-running feud with their powerful rival, Zafran Khan. When Zafran's men attack their fields, the violence that follows ignites a vow of retaliation from Sherdil, played by Ahsan Khan - a man whose very name suggests the storm he carries within him.
Beneath the conflict between these two families, locked in a grudge passed down through generations, is a younger generation quietly aching to break free. The love story at the drama's heart is tender and inevitable, but it blooms in soil soaked with injustice, feudal pride, and the suffocating weight of tradition.
It is Muddasir, played by Ameer Gilani - a friend who frequents the area - who falls for Rabia and the quiet world she has built around her little dhaba, with its organic garden and its unhurried rhythms.

‎اكبر افطار جماعي في العالم
‎(افطار المطرية)
‎تضم نحو 40 شارع في منطقة المطرية إلى مائدة إفطار رمضانية عملاقة، استقبلت أكثر من 100 ألف صائم خلال الإفطار الجماعي السنوي الذي ينظمه أهالي المنطقة.
‎وامتدت موائد الإفطار لمسافات طويلة داخل الشوارع، حيث اصطف المتطوعون من شباب وسكان الحي منذ ساعات مبكرة لتجهيز وترتيب الطاولات والكراسي استعداداً لاستقبال الصائمين القادمين من مختلف مناطق القاهرة للمشاركة في هذا الحدث الفريد.
‎وخلال التحضيرات، نجح أهالي المطرية في تجهيز ما يقرب من 100 ألف وجبة إفطار تم توزيعها على الصائمين لحظة أذان المغرب، وسط أجواء رمضانية مليئة بالبهجة وروح المشاركة.
‎وشهد الإفطار حضور عدد كبير من الزوار والضيوف الراغبين في مشاهدة هذا الحدث عن قرب، حيث تحولت المنطقة إلى كرنفال شعبي مميز يجسد كرم المصريين وروحهم الجماعية خلال شهر رمضان.
